discovery.client: scripts/discover.py finds each client module this addon imports by how the client uses it (for example `X.threadShellAtom(`) and follows the import chain to the chunk export that provides it. The DateTime constructor is found by its definition. Chunk names and export aliases are rendered into host.mjs from src/host.template at install time and recorded in the install receipt, never pinned.
discovery.onFailure: The install still proceeds because it only adds files and one script tag, and the prepared archive is verified to differ from the original only in those entries. At runtime the addon shows a dismissible note saying what could not be found.
